about.title: About us
about.description: Villa Venere is a beautiful villa overlooking the sea, located near the beaches of Cetara and the town center. It has 3 bedrooms with Smart TV and 2 bathrooms, one with a washing machine. The comfortable living room offers a beautiful sea view, alongside a well-equipped induction kitchen. A wonderful panoramic terrace overlooks the Tower and the Port of Cetara. The villa also has private access to the sea.
